source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Carrying fairly little established relationship at all between alcohol use and the client's overall long-term liver health","B":"Offering fairly little meaningful benefit once liver disease has already developed and progressed in the client","C":"Being relevant mainly for clients who already carry a formal diagnosis of alcohol use disorder specifically","D":"Reducing or eliminating alcohol intake can help slow progression of alcohol-related liver disease and support overall liver health"}}
source_row.rationale: Alcohol reduction counseling emphasizes that reducing or eliminating alcohol intake can help slow progression of alcohol-related liver disease and support overall liver health, benefits relevant even after some liver disease has already developed, not limited to clients with a formal alcohol use disorder diagnosis.
source_row.source_detail: Benefits of Alcohol Reduction for Liver Health
